The new specs under `context ".remove_member"` only cover removing an existing member and blocking automatic groups, and do not include an equivalent “non-member / non-existent user_id” removal case. This is a specific, diff-grounded gap in test coverage for newly introduced controller logic, not a demonstrable bug from the diff alone.
